'''LXC-3TF''' was as [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] that served alongside [[Jasta Finn]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was heavily armed with a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher and a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].
